about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Sukiyaki Kansai-Style Beef Hot Pot
recipes.summary: A tabletop pot of thinly sliced beef, tofu and vegetables simmered in a sweet soy broth, finished with noodles.
steps: Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and water together to make the broth.
Heat the oil in a wide pot, sear half the beef for 1 minute, then pour in half the broth.
Add the tofu, leek, mushrooms and cabbage in sections and simmer for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the remaining beef for the last 2 minutes so it stays soft, and top up with water if the broth reduces too far.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender, drain and slip them into the broth to finish.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C and serve piping hot. Do not dip cooked food into raw egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mizutaki Fukuoka Chicken Hot Pot
recipes.summary: A clear chicken broth pot with tender thigh pieces, tofu and winter vegetables, served with a ponzu-style dip.

items: 600g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks

steps: Put the water, kombu and chicken into a pot and bring slowly to a gentle simmer until the foam rises, skimming it off.
Simmer the chicken for 15 minutes, then lift out the kombu.
Add the carrots, cabbage and mushrooms and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and leek and cook 4 minutes more until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Stir the soy sauce, lemon juice and sugar into a dip and serve with the pot and ladled broth.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre and keep the pot at a gentle simmer. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chanko Nabe Sumo Wrestler Hot Pot
recipes.summary: A hearty chicken and meatball pot loaded with daikon, tofu and vegetables, the sumo training staple.

items: 400g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks

steps: Mix the minced chicken, egg, ginger and 1 tsp salt into a sticky paste and shape into 18 small balls.
Bring the water, soy sauce and mirin to a simmer in a large pot until steaming, then add the chicken chunks and daikon.
Simmer for 12 minutes, then drop in the meatballs and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the cabbage, mushrooms and tofu and simmer 8 minutes more until the meatballs reach 75°C inside.
Add the leek and noodles and cook 4 minutes until the noodles are tender.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken and meatballs to 75°C in the centre. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yudofu Kyoto Simmered Tofu Pot
recipes.summary: Silken tofu warmed in kombu broth with greens and mushrooms, dipped in soy and spring onion. Calm and light.

items: 400g silken tofu, cut into large cubes

steps: Rinse the rice, cook it with 1 1/2 cups water until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Put the water and kombu in a shallow pot and warm gently for 5 minutes, then remove the kombu.
Add the mushrooms and simmer 4 minutes, then slide in the tofu and heat very gently for 5 minutes without boiling.
Add the spinach for the last minute until just wilted.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger, sesame seeds and spring onion as a dip and serve with the pot and rice.

recipes.title: Budae Jjigae Korean Army Stew
recipes.summary: A bubbling spicy stew of kimchi, sausage, tofu and noodles from the post-war Uijeongbu kitchens.
steps: Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, sugar and garlic into a paste.
Arrange the kimchi, sausage, ham, tofu and onion in a wide pot and place the paste in the centre.
Pour in the water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook 6 minutes until tender, then scatter with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausages and ham until they reach 75°C and serve piping hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dakgalbi Chuncheon Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh, sweet potato and cabbage fried in a chilli paste, finished with melted cheese in the pan.

items: 700g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks
2 sweet potatoes, cut into thick sticks

steps: Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, sugar and garlic and coat the chicken in it.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the sweet potato for 6 minutes, then push aside.
Add the chicken and onion and fry for 8 minutes, then stir in the cabbage and cook 5 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Scatter the mozzarella over the top, cover for 2 minutes until melted and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Haemul Sundubu Clam and Egg Soft Tofu Pot
recipes.summary: A fiery bubbling pot of soft tofu, clams and chilli oil with a raw egg cracked in at the table.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Warm the sesame oil in a small pot, stir in the gochugaru and garlic for 30 seconds without burning.
Add the water, soy sauce and clams, bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes until the clams are opaque and firm.
Spoon in the tofu in large pieces, simmer 5 minutes, then crack in the eggs and cover for 3 minutes until the whites are firm.
Scatter with spring onion and serve bubbling with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the clams until they are hot throughout and the eggs until the whites are set. Contains egg and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gamjatang Pork Bone and Potato Stew
recipes.summary: A peppery pork-neck bone stew with potatoes and perilla-style greens, deeply savoury and warming.
steps: Cover the ribs with water in a large pot, boil for 10 minutes, drain and rinse them.
Return to the pot with the 8 cups water, onion, ginger and half the garlic and simmer for 50 minutes.
Stir the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and remaining garlic into the pot, add the potatoes and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the spinach and spring onions for the last 3 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve the stew over or beside it.
notes: Food safety: simmer the pork until it is fully tender and reaches at least 70°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jeonju Bibimbap Rice Bowl with Beef and Egg
recipes.summary: A rice bowl topped with seasoned beef, vegetables and a fried egg, mixed with gochujang at the table.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Toss the beef with 2 tbsp soy sauce, sugar and 1 tbsp sesame oil and fry in a hot pan for 4 minutes until cooked through.
Separately stir-fry the carrot and zucchini 2 minutes each, blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute and dress with the remaining soy and sesame oil.
Fry the eggs in the vegetable oil until the whites are firm.
Pile the rice into bowls, arrange the toppings and eggs on top and serve with the gochujang.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C and fry the eggs until the whites are set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dolsot Bibimbap Stone Pot Crispy Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Rice crisped in a hot oiled pot with vegetables and an egg, with a crackling base you scrape up.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Stir-fry the carrot, zucchini and mushrooms separately in a little vegetable oil for 2 minutes each.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute, drain and dress with soy sauce.
Heat two small heavy pans, brush with sesame oil, press in the rice and let it sizzle for 5 minutes until crisp underneath.
Arrange the vegetables on top, crack an egg on each and cover for 3 minutes until the whites are firm. Serve with gochujang.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tendon Prawn and Vegetable Tempura Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Crisp tempura over rice, glazed with a sweet soy sauce.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Simmer the soy sauce, mirin and sugar for 3 minutes until slightly syrupy.
Whisk the flour, sparkling water and egg lightly, leaving a few lumps.
Heat the oil to 175°C, dip the vegetables and prawns in batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until crisp, draining on paper.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the tempura and drizzle with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: fry the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C inside. Contains egg, gluten and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tekkadon Tuna and Avocado Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Seasoned tuna over warm sushi-style rice with avocado and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes, then stir through the rice vinegar and sugar.
Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce with the mirin and toss the tuna in it for 2 minutes.
Spoon the rice into bowls and fan out the tuna and avocado.
Scatter with sesame seeds, nori and spring onion and drizzle with the remaining soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: use only very fresh, sashimi-grade tuna kept cold until serving, and eat the same day. Pregnant people and the immunocompromised should choose cooked fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tamago Don Soft Egg and Onion Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Softly set eggs over onion simmered in dashi-style soy broth on rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Simmer the onion with the water, soy sauce, mirin and sugar for 5 minutes until soft.
Beat the eggs, pour over the onion in two stages, cover and cook 2 minutes until just set with no runny liquid.
Slide over the rice and top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ji Rou Fan Chiayi Shredded Chicken Rice
recipes.summary: Taiwanese shredded chicken over rice with a glossy shallot-garlic oil.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the water with the ginger and 1 tsp salt for 25 minutes until it reaches 75°C in the centre, then lift out and shred, discarding the skin and bones.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of the strained chicken broth until tender and fluffy.
Fry the shallots in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until golden, then stir in the soy sauce and sugar.
Pile the rice into bowls, top with chicken and spoon over the shallot oil.
Spoon the shallot oil over the rice, add the cucumber slices alongside and serve while the chicken is still warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sanbeiji Three-Cup Chicken with Basil
recipes.summary: Taiwanese claypot chicken braised in sesame oil, soy and rice wine until sticky, finished with basil.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Heat the sesame oil in a heavy pot and fry the ginger and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and brown for 6 minutes, then add the soy sauce, wine, sugar and chillies.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then uncover and boil 4 minutes until the sauce clings and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the basil and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Prawn Omelette Taiwanese Night Market Style
recipes.summary: Taiwanese night market omelette: prawns in a starchy omelette with greens and a sweet chilli sauce.
steps: Whisk the potato starch with the water until smooth.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the prawns and bok choy for 2 minutes until the prawns turn pink.
Pour in the starch mix, let it set for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Cook for 3 minutes until the eggs are set and the edges crisp, then flip and cook 1 minute.
Mix the tomato sauce, chilli sauce and soy sauce and spoon over the omelette.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C inside, and the eggs until set. Contains egg and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cai Pu Dan Radish Preserve Omelette
recipes.summary: A crisp omelette with salty preserved radish, served with rice.

items: 1/3 cup preserved radish, rinsed and chopped

steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Squeeze the radish dry and fry it in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the soy sauce, radish and spring onions.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the egg and cook 3 minutes over medium heat until golden underneath.
Flip and cook 2 minutes until fully set and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fan Qie Chao Dan Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Soft egg curds in a sweet-sharp tomato sauce over rice. Homely comfort.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble in 1 tbsp hot oil for 1 minute until just set, then set aside.
Fry the tomatoes in the remaining oil for 4 minutes until they collapse, stirring in the sugar and soy sauce.
Fold the egg back in with the spring onions and cook 1 minute until the egg is fully set.
Spoon the egg and tomato over the rice, scatter with any remaining spring onion and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bo Zai Fan Claypot Chicken and Mushroom Rice
recipes.summary: Hong Kong claypot rice with a crisp base, chicken, mushrooms and a ginger-soy finish.

items: 500g chicken thigh fillets, cut into pieces

steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce, the oyster sauce, ginger, sugar and sesame oil.
Rinse the rice and bring to a boil in the water in a heavy pot with a lid, then simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Lay the chicken and mushrooms on the rice, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Drizzle the vegetable oil around the edge, raise the heat for 2 minutes to crisp the base.
Mix the remaining soy sauce with 2 tbsp water, pour over, scatter with spring onions and stir at the table.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Luohan Zhai Buddha's Delight Vegan Braise
recipes.summary: A vegetarian monastery braise of tofu, mushrooms and vegetables in a deep, gently sweet sauce, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the tofu in the vegetable oil for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Add the mushrooms and carrots and fry 4 minutes, then pour in the water, soy sauce and sugar and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the broccoli, snow peas and tofu and simmer 4 minutes.
Stir the cornflour with 1 tbsp water, add and stir until glossy, then finish with sesame oil and cashews. Serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Dongpo Rou Hangzhou Braised Pork Belly
recipes.summary: Square pork belly braised until it melts, in soy and rice wine with a gloss of sugar, over greens and rice.
steps: Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse.
Line a heavy pot with the spring onions and ginger, add the pork skin side down, then the wine, soy sauce, sugar and water.
Cover tightly and simmer on very low heat for 2 hours until a knife slides in with no resistance.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, blanch the bok choy for 2 minutes.
Reduce the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes until syrupy, then spoon it over the pork and serve with rice and greens.
notes: Food safety: braise the pork until it reaches at least 70°C and is fully tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mala Chongqing Beef Hot Pot
recipes.summary: A numbing, fiery table pot of beef, tofu and vegetables in a chilli and Sichuan pepper broth.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pot and fry the doubanjiang, peppercorns, chillies, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the water and soy sauce, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the tofu, mushrooms and cabbage and cook for 6 minutes.
Swish the beef slices into the simmering broth for 1 to 2 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the noodles in the broth for the last 3 minutes until tender.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C and keep the pot at a steady simmer. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Guoqiao Mixian Crossing the Bridge Noodles
recipes.summary: A Yunnan chicken broth poured over raw ingredients at the table which cook in the heat.
steps: Simmer the whole chicken pieces in the water with the ginger and 1 tsp salt for 45 minutes, skimming, until the meat reaches 75°C.
Strain the broth and keep it at a full boil until you are ready to pour.
Cook the noodles in boiling water 4 minutes until tender, drain into four bowls.
Arrange the sliced chicken breast, spinach and mushrooms on the noodles and crack a quail egg on each.
Pour in the boiling broth, stir, wait 2 minutes until the breast slices turn opaque and the eggs set, then season with soy sauce and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: the broth must be at a full boil when poured so the thin chicken cooks to 75°C and the eggs are set; return to the pot if anything is pink. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mongolian Lamb Hot Pot with Tofu
recipes.summary: A copper-style broth with thin lamb, tofu and cabbage, dipped in sesame and chive sauce.
steps: Bring the water, ginger and spring onions to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Whisk the tahini, soy sauce and 2 tbsp warm water into a dipping sauce, stir in the chives.
Add the tofu, cabbage and mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes.
Swish the lamb slices through the broth for 1 to 2 minutes until cooked, then add the noodles for the last 3 minutes.
Serve with the sauce for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb to at least 71°C and keep the broth at a steady simmer. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hong Kong Claypot Lap Cheong Winter Rice
recipes.summary: Cured sausage and mushrooms steam through the rice in a heavy pot, finished with sweet soy.
steps: Rinse the rice and bring to a boil in the water in a heavy lidded pot, then simmer covered 10 minutes.
Lay the sausage and mushrooms over the rice, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil with 2 tbsp water.
Drizzle the vegetable oil down the side and cook 2 minutes uncovered to crisp the base, adding the bok choy for the last minute.
Pour over the sauce and toss until the rice is evenly coated, then serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausage to 75°C until steaming hot throughout. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chirashi Sushi Scattered Rice Bowl with Egg Ribbons
recipes.summary: Vinegared rice scattered with cooked prawns, egg ribbons, cucumber and nori; no raw fish, family friendly.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes, and fold in the vinegar and sugar while warm.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, cook thin omelettes in the oil until set, cool and cut into ribbons.
Spread the rice in bowls and arrange the prawns, egg ribbons, cucumber and carrot on top.
Scatter with nori and sesame seeds and serve with the soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: use prawns that are cooked and kept chilled until serving, and cook the eggs until set. Contains egg and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
